download_stream: one sequential HTTP stream per file
output_independence: worker counts are execution-only: they are normalized out of the selection hash and no output byte depends on completion order
pipeline: downloads continue while finished files are processed; at most 32 files hold scratch at once
process_worker_rule: largest measured process count that still adds 10% over the previous measured count, never above logical CPUs minus 4 (kept for the download streams, hashing, sealing and the system)
sixteen_workers: permitted by the resource contract (max 16); not a default and not benchmarked here
unit: files; never column or range requests
